verdict.rationale: First-party pages state the firm represents investors from angels to marquee VC and PE funds in priced rounds, convertible instruments and follow-ons. It also represents startups and growth companies through financings and exits, which covers both sides of the table. Its claimed deal volume (roughly 1,000 venture deals in two years; a Dow Jones top-five ranking cited by the firm) supports current market familiarity. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of market-terms insight (e.g., published deal-terms data or surveys), and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own site.
